title: Chat/set missing receiptSharing in update keys
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md line 862: Chat/set update-supports list for all chat kinds reads 'muted, muteUntil, receiveTypingIndicators, pinnedMessageIds, messageExpirySeconds'. The newly added Chat.receiptSharing field (line 441) is not included. Like the PresenceStatus/set omission, this makes the per-chat override field unreachable through the API. Fix: add receiptSharing to the Chat/set update-supports list for all chat kinds.
